# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

At SabaTech, we take security seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in any of our products, we encourage you to report it to us as soon as possible.

### How to Report

| Channel | Details |
|---------|---------|
| **Email** | security@sabatech.dev |
| **GitHub Security Advisories** | Use "Report a vulnerability" on any SabaTech-dev repo |
| **PGP** | Request our public key from security@sabatech.dev |

### Response Times

| Severity | CVSS | Acknowledgment | Fix Target |
|----------|------|----------------|------------|
| Critical | 9.0–10.0 | 24 hours | 7 days |
| High | 7.0–8.9 | 48 hours | 30 days |
| Medium | 4.0–6.9 | 72 hours | 60 days |
| Low | 0.1–3.9 | 7 days | Next release |

### Safe Harbor

We do not pursue legal action against good-faith security research. See our full [CVD Policy](docs/compliance/cvd-policy.md) for details.

## Compliance

- **Cyber Resilience Act (EU 2024/2847):** See [CVD Policy](docs/compliance/cvd-policy.md) and [Incident Reporting Procedure](docs/compliance/incident-reporting-procedure.md)
- **OWASP Top 10 2025:** See [Compliance Checklist](docs/OWASP_TOP10_2025_COMPLIANCE.md)
- **EU AI Act:** See [AI Literacy Policy](docs/compliance/AI_LITERACY_POLICY.md)
